Career Compass project evidence

Version 0.4.0 · October 29, 2026. One AI career coach is connected locally. Online hosting and final presentation work remain.

AI techniques

AI-assisted coding helped implement the web app. A server-side Responses API adapter supplies a bounded single-agent loop with guidance search, resume/job comparison, resume review, planning and interview review. The model retrieves guidance before generation; selected source IDs are checked and displayed with each reply.

Evidence and limits

83 automated tests pass. Small synthetic live runs demonstrate drafting and model-selected tools. The original 22 comparison cases are development regression examples, not a held-out benchmark. Citation support and personal facts still require review; source-ID validation does not establish correctness. No student study or job outcomes are claimed.

Privacy

In AI mode, messages, supplied documents, recent conversation, goals and retrieved guidance are sent through the backend to OpenAI. The key stays server-side. Requests use store:false, which does not promise zero provider retention. Use fictional or redacted demonstration data.

Materials

  • Readiness and remaining work
  • Five-minute presentation draft
  • Student testing protocol
  • Offline comparison evaluation

The current loopback address is local access. Online deployment and verification of instructor access are still required.
